day_shape: 127 items: Israel-Iran exchange paused after Trump-imposed ceasefire and reported call-off of major Israeli strike, US Apache down near Strait of Hormuz with crew safe, Trump claims Iran deal within days, Houthi drone downed over Eilat, heavy Khamenei/IRGC Muharram messaging.

threads.label: Israel-Iran exchange paused under Trump pressure
threads.summary: Israel and Iran said they were halting attacks after Trump imposed a new ceasefire, with reports that Netanyahu called off a major Iran strike after Trump warned Israel would be on its own. Iran International located one Israeli strike at the IRGC's Ahmad Kazemi missile complex near Najafabad; Home Front Command lifted most restrictions from 6am Tuesday.

threads.label: Trump pushes Iran deal, Vance defends terms
threads.summary: Trump told Jerusalem Post the US would finalise an Iran deal within days and achieve "total victory" within two weeks, while Vance called the deal a "home run for the American people, whether Israel likes it or not". Iran's parliamentary national security chair Ebrahim Azizi told CNN Tehran had "no problem" pursuing a deal; IRIB cited CNN saying Trump has claimed 37 times a deal was imminent.

threads.label: US Apache crash near Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: A US Army Apache helicopter went down near the Strait of Hormuz; Trump confirmed both crew members were rescued and said an incident report would follow Tuesday. The Jerusalem Post cited a former US ambassador to Oman saying Muscat's silence on possible cooperation with Iran in the Strait had "undermined their reputation" with US officials.

threads.label: Lebanon front and Houthi drones
threads.summary: IDF Arabic spokesperson Adraee issued evacuation warnings for Tyre and Zaqaq al-Mufti, Defence Minister Katz said Dahiyeh would be treated like northern Israeli communities, and Lebanese President Aoun urged talks and said he would not meet Netanyahu until a deal is signed. The IDF intercepted a Houthi drone over Eilat and reported a separate drone alarm from Lebanon in the Western Galilee.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and IRGC framing
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted recorded statements saying the "Zionist regime has drawn near to the final stages of its existence" and that studies had been conducted on opening fronts where the enemy is vulnerable, alongside Imam Khomeini anniversary material. Defa Press carried IRGC commendations, claims of a shift in the balance of power after the Israel exchange, and an MP saying Netanyahu's political survival depends on continued war.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Kerem Shalom closure
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck the Hamas Naval Police headquarters in Khan Yunis, killing cell commander Ismail al-Lahham, and confirmed a Saturday strike that killed three senior Palestinian Islamic Jihad operatives. The UN spokesperson said Israeli authorities closed the Kerem Shalom crossing — the only cargo crossing into Gaza operational over the past two weeks — following overnight missile attacks from Iran.

threads.label: Asset seizures and World Cup ticket dispute
threads.summary: IRIB reported further seizures of footballer Ali Karimi's assets and of 13 accused in Fars Province; an Iranian judge told Iran International confiscations of exiles' assets would weaken diaspora protests at embassies. The Iran Football Federation said the US had confiscated Iranian supporters' tickets ahead of the 2026 World Cup, with the first match against New Zealand on 15 June.

events.title: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action
events.summary: The U.S. Department of the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) is publishing the names of one or more persons that have been placed on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List (SDN List) based on OFAC's determination that one or more applicable legal criteria were satisfied. All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. OFAC is also publishing the names of one or more persons whose property and interests in property have been unblocked and who have been removed from the SDN List.
